We work where intelligence stops being a tool and starts becoming a presence.

06Frequently Asked

In plain terms.

01

What is akakAI?

akakAI is an AI research lab building autonomous agents that act on their own — systems that anticipate work, make decisions, and execute without prompting. Founded in 2026, headquartered in Dallas, Texas.

02

What does akakAI actually do for a business?

We build the AI layer beneath your operations. Instead of tools that wait for a human to click, our agents move first: monitoring signals, deciding what matters, and completing work end-to-end. Less supervision, fewer bottlenecks, more outcomes shipped.

03

How is this different from ChatGPT or other AI assistants?

Assistants respond. Our agents initiate. ChatGPT waits for a prompt; akakAI systems perceive their environment, form intent, and act — closing the loop between decision and delivery without a person in the middle.

04

What products does akakAI offer?

Two, both in production. Aegent is a sovereign agent platform — isolated, self-learning AI entities running continuously in the cloud. Optimal is an intelligent model router, sending each request to the strongest LLM for the job at a fraction of the cost.

05

Who founded akakAI?

Zayd Malik founded akakAI and serves as CEO. Abhiram Vishnubhotla leads agent development. akakAI operates as an independent research lab out of Dallas, Texas.

06

Where is akakAI headquartered?

Dallas, Texas, United States. We serve customers worldwide.
